hypothesis: The physical winning-number process remains compatible with a uniform 37-number wheel and lacks reproducible short-lag or wheel-neighbour dependence in a fresh fixed future sample.

primaryTests.statistic: maximum absolute standardized same-number match deviation across lags 1..20
primaryTests.null: serial independence with marginal sequence preserved by permutation
primaryTests.pValue: 10000 deterministic random permutations of the 5000-round winner sequence; max statistic recalculated each replicate
